+title: 'Cross-router residency tests: two routers on one pool share, price, and evict together'
+---
+Plan: `model-pool.md` §1.2, §3.
+
+## What
+Add `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/CrossRouterResidencyTests.swift`, a hermetic suite over stubs. Reuse the `LoadSpy`, `StubModelLoader`, `StubProbe`, `StubMetadataSource`, footprint constants, and `makeRouter` shape from `PooledResidencyTests.swift`. Move the shared stubs into `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers/ResidencyStubs.swift` if both suites need them, so nothing is copied.
+
+Each test builds two `Router`s. Both get the same `ModelPool()` unless the test says otherwise. Each router gets its own `LoadSpy` so the test can tell which router's loader ran.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Two routers on one pool that resolve one profile load each ref one time; the second router's loader records zero loads.
+- [ ] A release from the first router keeps the model resident; the second router's session still answers; zero evictions.
+- [ ] A release from the last router evicts every model one time, and the eviction runs through the loader of the router that loaded it (the first router's spy counts the evictions, the second router's spy counts zero).
+- [ ] A second router's resolve prices the first router's residents: a disjoint profile whose union with the first router's trio exceeds the budget throws `ResolutionFailure`, and `failure.budgetBytes` equals the host budget less the first trio's footprint.
+- [ ] Two routers on two different pools do not share: each ref loads two times.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter CrossRouterResidencyTests` → all pass.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `twoRoutersOnOnePoolLoadASharedRefOnce`
+- [ ] `releaseFromOneRouterKeepsTheModelForTheOther`
+- [ ] `lastReleaseEvictsThroughTheLoadingRoutersLoader`
+- [ ] `secondRouterPricesTheFirstRoutersResidents`
+- [ ] `twoRoutersOnTwoPoolsDoNotShare`
+- [ ] Run `swift test` → all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #model-pool #router-tests
\ No newline at end of file
